atoms.b: There are many different types of vitamins and minerals which are found in lots of different foods. ((++Fruits_and_vegetables Carbohydrates)) are packed with vitamins. For example, ((++oranges beef)) are packed with vitamin C and ((++carrots cakes)) give us vitamin A.

We find minerals in lots of different foods, but foods from the ((++proteins fats_and_sugars)) group are particularly rich in minerals; for example, ((++nuts lettuce)), egg and ((++fish oil)). Because we need a wide range of vitamins and minerals to keep our immune system strong, it is important to make sure your diet is ((++varied unvaried)).

Fibre is important because it helps with ((++digestion breathing)). It can be found in fruits, ((++vegetables butter)), cereals and wholegrain carbohydrates, like ((++brown white)) bread.

Water also helps with digestion, as it keeps the food ((++moving still)) through the digestive system. It also helps us keep our blood sugar levels and ((++temperature hands)) steady. The NHS recommends that we drink ((++6-8 100)) glasses a day.
